data.verdict: The ∂̄/Dolbeault route supplies the GENUS-LINEAR MODE COUNT but NOT the 1/π. Factor A: Riemann–Roch on K gives h⁰(K)=g=dim H^{1,0}, b₁=2g=8 — the forced genus-linear source the χ-vs-g obstruction demanded (from ∂̄, not the scalar heat kernel). Factor B: the ∂̄-index χ(O)=1−g=χ/2 is χ-proportional (rational/log), so no spectral determinant (scalar OR ∂̄) produces a bare 1/π. Hence 1/(8π) = (1/b₁)·(1/π): the mode-count 1/b₁ is FORCED (Hodge), and the residual 1/π is the archimedean dilog regulator (conj:dilogarithm-archimedean-limit, Part A proved / Part B open) — the same μ-independent π behind the proved 2/(3π) Bloch term. So the entire open α_EM 1/(8π) MAGNITUDE reduces to that ONE named conjecture (Part B), not to missing spectral geometry. A reduction/connection, not a closure. No fit; no instance; 1/(8π) phase-4; nothing wired.

caveats: Reduction, NOT closure. Factor A (mode count 1/b₁) is forced by Hodge/Riemann–Roch. Factor B (1/π) is NOT any spectral determinant — it is the archimedean dilog regulator (Part B, open). The α_EM 1/(8π) magnitude reduces to that single named conjecture.
